period_note: Standalone (solo) basis, from the 'Statement of Financial Position (Unaudited) as at 31 March 2014' and 'Statement of Comprehensive Income (Unaudited) for the period ended 31 March 2014' blocks (distinct from the 'Consolidated Statement of Financial Position' and 'Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income' blocks on the same infographic page). Solo basis confirmed by reconciliation: the P&L's period retained-earnings addition (164,002,275) exactly equals the solo balance sheet's retained-earnings movement (1,886,113,945 - 1,722,111,670). Matches the basis of this bank's own 2012-2016 Q4/annual series (solo). Consolidated cross-reference (same date, for comparison only, NOT used as primary): Total Assets 188,363 BDT_million, Total Liabilities 173,162, Total shareholders' equity (BRAC Bank Ltd) 14,376, Minority interest 825, Total equity 15,201, consolidated PAT 407 (attributable to BRAC Bank Ltd equity holders 286; minority -39), consolidated EPS 1.01. Balance sheet identity (solo) reconciles to within BDT 1 million: 164,099 (Total Liabilities) + 12,069 (Total Equity) = 176,168 (Total Property and Assets). Every P&L subtotal reconciles to within BDT 1 million (rounding). DATA QUALITY FLAG: this filing's own December-2013 comparative column (a contemporaneous figure, filed within ~3 months of that date) shows Solo Total Property and Assets = BDT 171,902mn and Consolidated = BDT 185,576mn as at 31 Dec 2013 -- both figures independently corroborated by the 2014 Q3 filing's own Dec-2013 comparative column (identical to the million). This disagrees by ~4.3% with the existing bank_financials/BRACBANK/quarterly/2013_Q4.json record (total_assets 179,713 BDT_million), which was sourced from a 2016 Annual Report's retrospective 'Five Years' Financial Summary' table rather than a contemporaneous filing. Per project convention (prefer the contemporaneous figure), 2013_Q4.json's total_assets may warrant review in a future pass; not corrected here as 2013_Q4.json is outside this task's scope.
